server.note: Add Server = 添加服务器, Remove Server = 移除服务器.

tab.note: New Tab = 新标签页, Close Tab = 关闭标签页.

view.note: View limit = 视图上限/视图数上限; also the View menu = 视图.

popout window.note: Popout Menu = 弹出窗口菜单; pop out (verb) = 弹出.

notification area.note: Some settings strings render it as 系统托盘 instead; 通知区域 matches the Windows term.

Dock.note: Apple's official macOS zh-CN term; existing strings use 程序坞图标.

badge.note: unread badge = 未读角标; existing strings use 红色角标 for the red badge.

bounce.note: Bounce the Dock icon = 弹跳程序坞图标.

flash.note: Flash taskbar icon = 闪烁任务栏图标.

start app on login.note: Launch app minimized = 以最小化方式启动应用.

hardware acceleration.note: GPU hardware acceleration = GPU 硬件加速.

dark mode.note: Toggle Dark Mode = 切换深色模式.

title bar.note: native title bar = 原生标题栏.

zoom.note: Zoom In = 放大, Zoom Out = 缩小, Actual Size = 实际大小.

clear data.note: Clear All Data = 清除所有数据; Clear Cache and Reload = 清除缓存并重新加载.
